cases.raw_task: Could you help with this investigation? Help me distinguish throttling, an out-of-memory limit, and memory protection when investigating a latency regression. The affected inference service runs in a Linux memory cgroup, and I can collect host-memory pressure and event counters for that group and its children. Give a diagnostic plan that separates local events from child activity and considers pressure on sibling workloads; explain the limits of any protection guarantee, but do not change settings or claim a measured improvement.

cases.source_limits: Proposed diagnosis only: distinguish host memory pressure, limits and best-effort protection; no settings changes or claimed measured benefit.

cases.raw_task: Could you advise on this memory issue? Propose how to investigate retained host RAM from large, rarely reused pinned buffers and decide which allocator options are relevant. The workload uses TorchNPU, and we have not yet verified the installed versions or whether pin_memory_expandable_segments=True is active. First establish the applicable version and allocator-path gates, describe the trade-offs of any proposed settings in fresh-process trials, and distinguish host allocation from device memory; do not run trials, promise a total-cache quota, or free buffers that are still in flight.

cases.raw_task: Please help me check this download. Explain how to tell whether a sharded model download is complete and how to recover only what is missing.
